About

I study B.Tech at Bharati Vidyapeeth's College of Engineering in New Delhi and graduate in 2029.

My projects so far are web tools built with teammates: a finance education and planning site, EveryRupee, and a marketing assistant for clay artisans, Mitti AI. Both call the Google Gemini API, and I came up with the Mitti AI idea and built its AI section.

I also run outreach for Techshuttle, my college's technical society. Right now I'm learning Rust and looking for open-source programs where I can start contributing.

Projects

Both are team projects that are still in progress. Each panel separates what I built from what my teammates built.

Team project, in progress

EveryRupee

Many people in India learn about loans, cards and UPI scams only after something goes wrong. EveryRupee explains money in plain language, with fraud warnings, and helps people plan. It is free and needs no signup.

What I built

The Financial Education hub: eight topics (debit and credit cards, net banking, UPI, cheques, loans, EMI and bank documentation), each with fraud warnings, plus a plain-language glossary.

What the team built

A multi-step financial planner, tax and investment pages, and a finance-only assistant built on the Google Gemini API and restricted to finance questions.

Team project, in progress

Mitti AI

Clay and terracotta artisans make beautiful products but often have no marketing skills to show them online. Mitti AI turns one product photo into the words they need.

What I built

The idea, and the AI generation section: a product photo goes to the Google Gemini API and comes back as a description, an Instagram caption, SEO keywords and design ideas.

What the team built

The web interface: landing page, dashboard and idea generator.
